title: Industrial Decarbonization Is Good for Business
content: With major governments showing open hostility toward climate solutions or focusing on other needs, one might think that progress toward decarbonization is in jeopardy. Yet across the global industrial sector, many companies are increasing productivity, boosting revenue growth, and reducing emissions all at once.

title: When the AI Bubble Bursts
content: Speculative bubbles often leave behind valuable infrastructure while bankrupting the investors who financed them. AI could follow the same path, but the industry’s growing reliance on borrowed money raises the risk of a major financial crisis long before its world-beating applications emerge.

title: After Brazil and Serbia’s Elections
content: The recent electoral defeat of far-right forces in Brazil and Serbia offers important lessons for pro-democracy forces around the world as they confront nationalist and illiberal movements. But no single election can guarantee democracy’s resilience, and the challenges these countries’ new governments face remain formidable.

title: The New Geopolitics of Mining
content: While the US and China want their critical-mineral investments to deliver the biggest returns possible, governments in resource-rich countries must balance external pressures with internal demands. Mining firms must also win local communities’ trust, as host countries will be quick to throw them under the bus if public opinion sours.

title: Can Bond Vigilantes Prevent the Next Debt Crisis?
content: With interest rates on government debt having gone from near zero to much higher levels in recent years, rising short- and long-term bond yields have cast doubt on the sustainability of some debts and led many to wonder if a crisis might be looming. While some countries are more protected than others, none is immune.

title: A Wealth Tax Would Harm California
content: Before approving a one-time tax on the wealth of billionaires who lived in the state at a certain point in time, Californians should consider what such a policy will do to future tax revenues. Since wealth is mobile, those who stand to lose the most will simply leave, taking their future income-tax payments with them.

title: A Future for Europe’s Youth
content: The current generation of young Europeans possesses freedoms, material resources, opportunities to travel, and technological capabilities beyond anything previous generations could have imagined. Their demands, however, are strikingly simple: decent schools, secure jobs, affordable homes, and the possibility of raising a family.
